capabilities.rationale: Security infrastructure for the Case Manager service boundary, not a user capability. server/backend/case_manager_auth.py resolves the acting identity and read clearance from a verified credential instead of from client-supplied X-Case-Actor / X-Case-Clearance headers, closing the privilege escalation and audit-trail forgery recorded as finding D4 in docs/GAP_ANALYSIS_AND_OPTIMIZATION_2026-09.md. server/backend/local_request.py is the loopback trust boundary it shares with the API-key store. Neither module has or should have a GUI surface: they are enforcement that runs underneath every /cases route, and AGENTS.md classifies security-sensitive controls as internal while still requiring user-relevant outcomes to surface. The outcomes here are HTTP status codes on the Case Manager API itself (403 off-box, 503 unconfigured, 401 unknown token), which its own consumers receive directly. The Case Manager's absent dashboard workflow is tracked separately by the existing case-manager-phase-1-gui-gap exception; this entry does not widen or substitute for it.
